title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.33 (quiet) at 23:17 UTC on 18 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 18 日 23:17 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest complete-minute estimated Kp = 1.33 (label 1P). Last-180-sample maximum is 1.67 (at 22:13 UTC); published-window maximum is 1.67 (at 22:13 UTC). Hours through 16:00 UTC have rolled out of the public window. Residual 17:00 UTC slice: peak 1.00 / 1Z (40 samples, closed at 1.00 / 1Z). Completed bins 18:00–22:00 UTC closed at 0.00 / 0.67 / 0.67 / 1.33 / 1.67 respectively. In-progress 23:00 UTC bin: 1.33 / 1P after 18 samples (hour peak 1.67 / 2M at 23:00 UTC). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最新完整分鐘估計 Kp = 1.33（標籤 1P）。近 180 筆最大 1.67（22:13 UTC）；公開窗最大 1.67（22:13 UTC）。至 16:00 UTC 已滾出公開窗。殘留 17:00 UTC 切片：峰值 1.00／1Z（40 筆，收在 1.00／1Z）。18:00–22:00 UTC 已結束（分別收在 0.00／0.67／0.67／1.33／1.67）。23:00 UTC 進行中（18 筆、目前 1.33／1P；本時峰值 1.67／2M 於 23:00 UTC）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest complete minute (not a lone new-hour 0.00 placeholder). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window (~358 samples), so earlier hours fall out of the file.
